docs.title: Country Monitor
docs.text: Welcome to the Country Monitor project. This site provides countrymonitor datasets ICMP-based full block surveys to detect Internet disruptions.

docs.title: What we publish
docs.text: We provide aggregated block-level data only: - Number of responding IPs per timestamp - Mean and variance of RTT - Ever-active IPs per month

docs.title: What we do not publish
docs.text: The raw dataset contains individual Ukrainian IPs and their responsiveness. Publishing this data could put people and networks at risk. Release will only be reconsidered in collaboration with Ukraine’s national CERT after the war.

docs.title: How to request access
docs.text:
Researchers can request restricted access under a Data Use Agreement (DUA). measurements@sba-research.org
